summary: 1 blocking finding is valid and will be repaired by specifying the implementation commit fallback source.

items.title: Implementation commit fallback is ambiguous in real finalize history
items.rationale: R2 currently says to use implementation commit subject summary but does not define how finalize metadata/report commits are excluded. This can produce a non-implementation subject in real finalize history.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1].desc and overview.data_flow[0].text mention feature branch implementation commit subject but do not specify filtering or ordering. spec-review.json cites finalize metadata/report commits as real branch history entries.
